aiTitle: Fix modal state persisting across navigation

content.text:
Approach #2 (no modals on iPad) is better. Here's why:

**Why the bug happens:** `@react-navigation/stack` keeps pushed screens inside the same presentation context. Once you present `startChat` as a modal, anything pushed on top (the room screen) stays inside that modal sheet. On iPhone modals are full-screen so you don't notice; on iPad they're form/page sheets so the visual leak is obvious. Both your fixes work around this — only #2 fixes the root cause.

**Why not "reset on room tap":**
- You'd have to remember to do this at every modal → push boundary (room from startChat, room from forwardMessage, user from invitePeople, etc. — there are 9 modal screens in [RootNavigator.tsx:62-204](src/modules/navigation/components/root-navigator/RootNavigator.tsx#L62-L204)).
- Resetting the stack loses back history, which changes app behavior on iPhone too unless you fork the logic per platform.
- Easy to forget when adding a new modal-launched flow later.

**Recommended:** gate `presentation: "modal"` on `!isTablet` (or whatever flag you're already using on the `feature/ipad-layout` branch). One small helper, applied to all 9 screens:

```ts
const modalOptions = isTablet
  ? undefined
  : {
      presentation: "modal" as const,
      gestureEnabled: Platform.OS === "ios",
      ...TransitionPresets.ModalPresentationIOS,
    };
```

iPad gets push transitions (which suit the larger canvas anyway), iPhone keeps its modal sheets, and you don't have to think about presentation context every time you push from a modal.

Want me to apply this in [RootNavigator.tsx](src/modules/navigation/components/root-navigator/RootNavigator.tsx)?

The `isIpad` helper already exists at [src/shared/utils/is-ipad.ts](src/shared/utils/is-ipad.ts). I'll apply it in [RootNavigator.tsx](src/modules/navigation/components/root-navigator/RootNavigator.tsx) to gate the modal options.

  About,
  BlockedUsers,
  CantConfirm,
  ConfirmIdentity,
  CreateRoom,
  DeactivateAccount,
  EditRoom,

  EnterRecoveryKey,

  VerifyUser,
  VerifyWithDevice,
  Welcome,

const Stack = createStackNavigator<Routes>();

aiTitle: Fix modal state persisting across navigation

content.text:
All 11 modal screens now use the gated `modalOptions` / `verifyUserOptions` constants. On iPad they evaluate to `undefined` (regular push transitions, no modal context), on iPhone they keep the original modal presentation.

One thing worth noting: this only affects the JS stack navigator. Bottom sheets (`AppBottomSheet`) and any other modal-style overlays are unaffected and keep their existing iPad-aware behavior.
